'''Muscle Out''' is a [[:Category:Effects|Potion Effect]] added in v1.10.0 of SRP. Greatly increases the host’s outgoing damage. Attacks are multiplied by a configuration-based factor that scales with effect strength (amplifier + 1).

Muscle Out does not stack.
